newsitem.title: UK: ASDA up on Capel comment and CBI survey.
newsitem.headline: ASDA up on Capel comment and CBI survey.

text.p: Shares in ASDA Group Plc climbed on Thursday, leading shares in food retailers higher, after positive comment by brokerage HSBC James Capel and an encouraging CBI survey on UK retail sales, market sources said.
ASDA shares gained 8-1/2p to 135-1/2p by 1025 GMT in volume of over 10 million shares.
HSBC analyst Kate Calvert declined to comment.
The Confederation of British Industry (CBI) survey said UK retail sectors, with the exception of footwear and leather goods, reported an increase in sales in June compared with a year earlier.
Elsewhere in the food retailers' sector, shares in Safeway Plc jumped 18p to 368-1/2p, J. Sainsbury Plc rose 16-1/2p to 380p and Tesco Plc advanced 22-1/2p to 397p.
